{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Not in the catalog — referenced by name from a report or Template Editor field
{{% /callout %}}

Not a tool you click — a computed value you reference from a Template Editor field or a report/BOM column, typed as `CUSTOM.CLASS_BASED`. It reads a part's own Class and returns a computed value, usable in an integer, double, or character field alike. This is expected to grow more custom properties over time, not just this one.

<blockquote class="page-note"><strong>Two versions ship</strong>: <code>uCustomProperty</code> for Tekla 2026, and <code>uCustomProperty2024</code> for Tekla 2024 and 2025. If <code>CUSTOM.CLASS_BASED</code> does not evaluate after installing <code>uCustomProperty</code> on a Tekla 2025 machine, install <code>uCustomProperty2024</code> there instead.</blockquote>
